en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Intorduction to the problem of scientific work and pedagogical research; specificity of quantitative, qualitative and mixed research design; gaining information about basic research technics used in pedagogical research; development of skills connected with data analysis and interpretation and writing research report.
